messages:
nate: Quick kickoff 1: planning a selective unpin tomorrow 02:00 UTC for runtime 2.9 -> 3.0. We need an "escape hatch" for quantized variants and older SDK clients.

rachel: Are we unpinning all routes or just generate/chat?

nate: Targeting generate/chat first. Keeping embed + rerank pinned until we verify quality signals.

samir: Important: Our quant-v2 models still require runtime 2.9 kernels. If we unpin those hostnames they'll OOM. Need route-level pinlist.

elaine: I can add a host-affinity rule that keeps quantized model hostnames on 2.9. Do we have the hostname set for those models?

nate: Yes, list is in infra inventory PR #872. I'll attach after this thread.

deploybot: change window scheduled at 1716830400 (02:00 UTC). Canary cohort: can-q1-03, 8% traffic for 20m. Roll plan: 8% -> 30% -> 100% with 15m hold checks.

rachel: Rollback triggers propose: immediate rollback if error > 1% for 5m OR if model quality regression alert fires. Any objections?

ops-bot: Confirmed: auto-rollback on error>1% sustained 5m. Also will post a sticky-pin to any route that hits model-eval regression.

samir: Also request a telemetry tag for "sdk_client_version" so we can correlate regressions to old clients.

sdk-team: Working on tagging in the agent; hotfix build ready for nightly. If it lands before roll, we can be more aggressive on embed unpin.

nate: Decision: generate/chat -> unpinned to 3.0 per schedule. embed/rerank remain pinned to 2.9 until we get SDK uptake and eval pass.

deploybot: Canary metrics after 18m: errors 0.2%, p95 +9% overall.  Longseq subset p95 +30%.

elaine: Longseq hit again. We should enable the new sequence-trim config for canary to reduce kernel pressure.

samir: Sequence-trim enabled on canary. Also limited batch size to 8 for seq>2048.

deploybot: Canary re-run: errors 0.15%, longseq p95 +14%.

rachel: Good. Move to 30% if no change. Also notify support to expect possible embedding support tickets if embed gets unpinned later.

support-bot: Noted. Drafted support playbook: steps to revert a customer's route to pinned runtime 2.9, and guidance for customers on SDK upgrade paths.

nate: Added a short release blurb: "Runtime 3.0 rollout starts. Embedding and reranking routes remain pinned to 2.9 for compatibility with SDK <2.6 and quantized models. No action required for most users."

sdk-team: If nightly hotfix merges, we can advertise SDK 2.6.1 and shorten pin window to 48h.

deploybot: 30% metrics steady. Scheduling full 100% in 3h if stable.

ops-bot: Reminder: ops will auto-apply sticky-pin for any route hitting the quality-eval alert. Engineers, please watch eval dashboards.

samir: Post-roll followups: INF-4901 for better hostname tagging of quant hosts, INF-4902 to add an e2e test that asserts no silent embedding-quality drift between runtimes.

rachel: Added those tickets. Also, can we include a short note in the changelog about "hostname-level pins for quantized model safety"?

nate: Yup will add to release notes and the dedicated customers email.

deploybot: Rollout complete (100%). Final metrics: global error 0.12%, p95 +7%; embed routes still pinned.

elaine: Closing thread. If anyone sees regression alerts, ping #eng-oncall AND this thread.

support-bot: Support playbook link: https://redwood.corp/support/runbooks/runtime-pinning.

nate: Thanks all. Follow-ups in INF tickets.
